title: Road Accident Dashboard
headline: A clearer picture of road safety.
summary: An interactive view of UK road accidents, designed to make trends, conditions and geographical patterns easier to explore.

cover.alt: The original Road Accident Dashboard, showing casualty comparisons, conditions and a UK accident map.

coverNote: Dashboard image from the project repository. Open the Tableau dashboard to explore the interactive version.

blocks.html:
The question

How can accident statistics become a useful view of where, when and under which conditions road accidents occur?

What it shows

A single place to explore year-over-year trends and accident hotspots, then look closer at the conditions behind them.

The approach

Bring casualty comparisons, vehicle types, weather and road conditions into a Tableau dashboard. Connect the statistics to a geographical view and offer filters for year and severity.
